_comment: One-time inputs for PrepAzimuthReferences (terra_wdl/prep_azimuth_references.wdl). Run as a STANDALONE Terra submission with NO root entity -- every input is a literal gs:// path. Runs SCTransform+RunPCA on the two raw reference atlases ONCE and emits AHBA_sct_pca.rds / Ma_Sestan_sct_pca.rds. After the run succeeds, copy the two workflow outputs into gs://fc-dde46beb-1862-45cf-92bc-06c767e05710/references/azimuth/ (the paths scorch_pfc_downstream_inputs.json's ahba_ref_rds / ma_sestan_ref_rds point at), then run the downstream workflow. Needs the big 416 GB machine ONCE. azimuth_docker must be sha-591b780 or newer (the image that contains prep_azimuth_references.R).
